reviews.text: I went to Arcaplanet Imbonati this morning. Marta is my favorite, always kind and helpful. If you don't find a product, she'll get it off the shelf. She's very knowledgeable, like a veterinarian, and recommends lactic acid bacteria and other products for my cat's renal diet.
Thank you, Elena Sicurella, your little stars made us shine! Come back and visit us.
Thank you, Chiara Generali. We're delighted to hear your positive feedback about Arcaplanet! Thank you so much for your trust.
Thank you, Mina, for taking the time to share your review with us! Come visit us again soon at Arcaplanet stores!
Thank you, Hossan Mohammad Jakir. We're delighted to hear your positive feedback about Arcaplanet! Thank you so much for your trust.
Very kind and helpful staff

Since the employees are very kind and helpful, I'd like to point something out. Yesterday, Sunday, June 28th, I entered the Arcaplanet store on Via Imbonati. I'd like to point out that there was no air conditioning, making the environment unbreathable and suffocating. This created a condition of discomfort and health problems for both customers and the employee. The store is also exposed to the sun on two sides, creating a heat wave that builds up throughout the day.
These inhumane conditions that the employees have to endure need to be highlighted.

During my purchase, I was not given any information about the possibility of registering my four-legged friend for the dedicated program, which would have allowed me to benefit from a 30% discount on purchased products. Since the store staff didn't inform me of this opportunity, I paid full price. The sales assistants are unprofessional.
Thank you, Carlos Helguero, your little stars made us shine! Come back and visit us.
Thank you, Paolo Panzeri, for your review. We hope to see you again soon!

Wide range and friendly and helpful staff
Great place where you can find everything for our 4-legged friends... from food to clothing for the various seasons and for comfort... I will be back... by the way, excellent quality/price 👍 …

Today I went to this store, unfortunately I didn't have a good experience, since I had bought some vitamins for my dog. I have the habit of not checking the receipt when I get home, but I did and I saw that they charged me full price for the vitamins, when they were discounted at 30% and they made me pay for 3 pieces instead of 2, but in the end I didn't go back for fear of being criticized...

I came in to get a product, the staff was uninterested and rude, especially the blonde sales assistant, who had no desire to work and an annoyed look because I interrupted her chat with her colleague.
Coldness and indifference always welcome you
Normal reception

They don't care if you've been a customer for months, how polite you are, or how much you try to engage in conversation out of politeness. They won't greet you or even offer a smile. The staff is really rude, and unfortunately, it's the only place to shop in the area.
Absurd prices even compared to the supermarket (for example, Frontline costs 44 euros instead of 34 at Esselunga or 22 on Amazon) and incredibly rude shop assistants.
Nothing to say
excellent......valid products at affordable prices
Shop with qualified and attentive staff. We cater to all animal species: cats, dogs, birds, and rodents. Always open and available.

It's a shame that pet stores have a vast selection, but at much higher prices than the few items you find in the supermarket. Luckily, I use them and find them to be of good quality. The staff is impassive, they barely say hello, and you'll always find them chatting among themselves. They have zero love for their work and zero respect for their customers.
helpful staff
Very kind and polite

Really rude staff, they don't say hello when you come in, you ask for things, and they barely know how to give you directions. They don't know the products they have in store. You ask if they have a product and they tell you they're out of it. Then when you (the customer) find it, they say... "ah yes," really awful. Never again! Rating 0. If you need a product, go to Viale Certosa instead, where the staff is more competent and kind.
